project_context.positioning: Premium B2B Technology Transformation Company. High-end consulting, not a dev shop.
project_context.vibe: Awwwards-level, 'Godly website' standard. Dark-dominant, high-contrast, sharp grids, architectural precision.

rules.headings: Space Grotesk. Tightly tracked (-0.02em to -0.04em). Line-height tight (leading-none to leading-tight).
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans. High legibility. Loose line-height (leading-relaxed).
rules.labels: Space Grotesk, Uppercase, wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]), small size (text-xs to text-sm).

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl (fluid, max 7xl for hero)

strategies.dark_mode: Default. Background #000000. Cards #1A1A1A. Text #F6F0DE or #FFFFFF. Accents #FA942C.
strategies.accents: Do not flood sections with #FA942C. Use it as a precision laser: buttons, active borders, thin 60-degree diagonal motion motifs.

visual_enhancers.motion_signature: Thin diagonal orange line / diagonal hatch lines at ~60 degrees. Implement via CSS gradients or SVG patterns.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: The 'Grid Borders' (Technical Look). 1px solid borders (#4D4D4D in dark, #E5E5E5 in light) to show the architectural skeleton. No soft drop shadows in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for Sticky Header. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a delicate 1px bottom border.

motion.hero: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Text slides up from a hidden overflow container.
motion.scroll: Lenis for momentum scrolling. Staggered reveals for grids on scroll via framer-motion.
motion.marquee: Extremely slow 'editorial' marquee for the wordmark or tagline. Low contrast against background.
motion.hover: High contrast shifts. Buttons translate slightly. Grid items highlight border to #FA942C.

layouts.spacing: Generous. py-20, py-32. Ensure elements breathe. 2-3x more spacing than typical templates.
layouts.bento_grids: For Capabilities (11 services) and Industries. Sharp rectangular grid, gap-0 or gap-px, with border-collapse feel to create continuous architectural lines.
layouts.alignment: Prioritize sharp left-alignment for text. Avoid the generic 'center everything' disease.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtly pill-shaped. Primary: bg-[#FA942C] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors.
components.cards: bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-[#4D4D4D] p-6 to p-8. Avoid rounded corners for a sharper enterprise feel (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
components.forms: Customize Shadcn Inputs to be bg-transparent, border-b only or sharp 1px border. Focus ring should be #FA942C. Never use generic HTML inputs.
components.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism (bg-black/60 with blur), clear active states. Desktop links fully visible. NEVER fully transparent.
components.accordions: FAQ should use a sharp, 1px bordered accordion, distinct from standard shadcn.

media.treatment: Images should have a subtle greyscale or high-contrast filter applied in dark mode, optionally colorizing on hover. Max overlay opacity: bg-black/50, let the image breathe.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for framer-motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a premium marketing site for AADRIQUE TECH PVT LTD. Vibe: Apple/Stripe meets Awwwards agency.
Construct standard React components. Do not over-rely on pre-built UI components if they restrict layout creativity. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in an App or Layout wrapper.
Set up Framer Motion for the Kinetic line-by-line Hero reveal and page transitions.
The 11 Capabilities must be rendered in a dynamic grid, using the 'Technical Look' (visible 1px borders).
Install required icons (lucide-react or phosphor-icons) and fonts.
Include a system-aware dark/light mode toggle. Remember dark mode is preferred for this aesthetic.
Build the multi-page structure with React Router: Home, About, Capabilities, Industries, Work, Insights, FAQ, Contact, Privacy, Terms.
You are writing .js files, NOT .tsx files. Skip TypeScript types.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath (e.g. Header).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties excluding transforms.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts the human natural reading flow.
Use modern button styles (sharp or pill) with interaction animations & brand color.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
